thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging inference-oncall — p95/p99 latency spike detected for /v1/streaming/generate across prod us-west-2. SLO breach triggered at 2026-03-15T14:02:01Z. Auto-alert: p95=1.2s (baseline 260ms), p99=6.5s (baseline 1.1s). Error rate (5m) +5.6% with streaming stalls and client reconnects. Escalation level: P1.

Sam Chen: ack, I'm on it. grabbing dashboards now. Any customer-facing noise?

Eve K (Customer Success): multiple customers reported streaming stalls in the last 10m, a handful opened support tickets with session hung at initial tokens. Not many 5xx, more timeouts and partial streams.

Marcus Li: seeing a fat tail on the gateway logs — many downstream 429/503s from configstore and auth-service. sample from worker logs:

```
[14:01:54Z] WARN upstream=configstore status=429 path=/config/v1/fetch?env=prod shard=us-west-2
[14:01:55Z] ERROR auth-service timeout=1200ms status=503 token_check
[14:01:56Z] WARN model-runtime stream_id=xx tail_delay=3200ms kv_miss=true
```

Priya Patel: checking configstore dashboard — spike in fetch QPS around 14:00 coincident with a feature-flag rollout. throughput jumping from 2k/s -> 17k/s; token bucket exhaustion. Also see increased 5xx.

Sam Chen: interesting. Could be fanout from a flag change causing every replica to re-fetch. eng-sre, can we see recent flag rollouts?

eng-sre: rollouts: ff_rapid_release started at 13:59:47 by product-support (canary->region-wide). That's consistent. It triggers per-tenant config recompute and invalidates cached prefixes.

Marcus Li: gateway behavior: when configstore responds 429, auth checks backoff and we hit code path that forces synchronous config fetch before streaming starts -> stalls. So streaming requests block until config fetch or auth check completes, causing p99 to blow up.

Sam Chen: mitigation plan idea — 1) pause flag rollout to stop additional invalidations, 2) enable fallback cached config path (return last-known config with degraded TTL), 3) temporarily relax strict auth-config sync for streaming route to use cached token validation for 30s, 4) scale configstore horizontally and bump rate-limit window. Which ones are low-risk and fast?

Priya Patel: pause rollout = 30s via product-console. cached-config fallback is a config change on the controlplane with small risk (it returns stale flags but keeps streams alive). auth relax needs code path toggle but we have a runtime toggle `auth.sync_on_start` — can flip to `false` in prod for streaming until healthy.

product-support: paused ff_rapid_release at 14:03:12 :white_check_mark:.

Sam Chen: flipping `auth.sync_on_start=false` for streaming route now (will scope to /v1/streaming). eng-sre, please monitor auth errors/latency after.

eng-sre: applying toggle via console -> rollout started. deploy-bot: "toggle-auth-sync v2 -> disabled for /v1/streaming" executed at 14:04:05.

ops-bot: autoscale event: configstore pool +3 instances at 14:04:50 (policy: queue-latency).

Marcus Li: immediate effect: streaming request tail latency dropping on new requests. p95 now 410ms, p99 trending down to 1.9s. partial restores for most sessions.

Eve K (Customer Success): early customers reporting streams resuming. A few sessions still stuck and need manual reconnect. Ticket updates pushed.

Sam Chen: next step — re-enable cached-config fallback on controlplane to avoid synchronous refetch. Priya, can you push the fallback?

Priya Patel: pushing cached-config fallback. Command: `kubectl apply -f cached-config-fallback=enabled` (pseudo). This will return last-known config on 429/503 for 60s. Applying now.

```
14:05:38 INFO config-controlplane: cached-fallback enabled ttl=60s
14:05:39 INFO configstore: incoming qps=9.3k (down from 17k)
```

Sam Chen: good. What about root cause: feature flag rollout caused mass cache invalidation -> configstore token bucket hit -> 429s -> auth path blocking streams. Need follow-up: change rollout strategy, add jitter to invalidations, and provide a cached fallback as default.

product-support: raising a post-incident action item: require rollout ramp to <=500 qps per region OR automatic stagger. Also add observability to detect config invalidation fanout.

eng-sre: I'll open a ticket to add rate-limit headroom and a circuit-breaker on controlplane path so we never block streaming path on upstream config failures.

Marcus Li: please note one downstream regression: an older runtime variant doesn't honor cached-config fallback and still blocks. We'll need a hotfix and to create a compatibility advisory.

Sam Chen: action list (short-term):
- paused rollout (product-support) :white_check_mark:
- disabled auth.sync_on_start for streaming (eng-sre) :white_check_mark:
- enabled cached-config fallback (Priya) :white_check_mark:
- scaled configstore +3 instances (ops-bot) :white_check_mark:
- manual reconnects for stuck sessions (customer success) ongoing

Sam Chen: action list (long-term):
- change rollout fanout behavior, add jitter/stagger
- add circuit-breaker so controlplane 5xx/429 don't block streaming
- increase configstore rate-limit headroom and alarms
- add per-tenant invalidation metrics + alerting
- backfill runtime variants to support cached fallback

Priya Patel: creating incident ticket INC-3719004321 and linking runbook: https://confluence.internal/runbooks/streaming-controlplane-fallback. Adding relevant logs and graphs.

Sam Chen: handing off to Priya for the post-mitigation sweep and coordination with product and CS. Priya, please summarize state and we'll close the page when customer impact resolved.

Priya Patel: state at 14:15Z: p95=320ms, p99=1.5s, error-rate back to baseline in last 5m. Still tracking ~12 tickets for reconnects. I'm taking ownership. Handoff notes: blocked-by hotfix for legacy runtime variant; need postmortem and rollout policy change. Last observed anomaly: configstore qps spike correlates with invalidation event at 13:59:47.

Sam Chen: thanks. I'll update the oncall rotation entry with summary. :thumbsup:

eng-sre: tagging follow-ups: ENG-INC-2026 (rollout policy), ENG-INC-2027 (circuit-breaker), ENG-INC-2028 (legacy runtime hotfix).

Eve K (Customer Success): continuing to update customers. will attach timeline and mitigation steps in tickets.

Priya Patel: closing temporary incident page. moving to postmortem draft. will ping owners for due dates. last_message: 14:23:20Z.

incident-bot: incident P1 -> mitigated. summary: controlplane config invalidation fanout caused configstore rate-limit exhaustion, causing auth sync to block streaming startup; mitigations: paused rollout, enabled cached fallback, disabled strict auth sync for streaming, scaled configstore. Follow-up required: rollout policy changes and runtime compatibility fix.

Sam Chen: handoff complete. Priya taking incident long-term. Good job team. :party_parrot:
